lines: Polish: the keyboard, shorthand, a smoother finish, and a subtle glow.

- **Fixed: the keyboard opens when you add a subtask.** The same goes for every field that opens by itself: a new subtask (from `+`, `+ SUB` or the hold menu), notes, and the quick-add bar when it's asked to take focus. Before, the field could open without a keyboard until you tapped it.

- **Shorthand chips show just above the text you're typing,** small and quiet, in the same style when adding and when editing. Typing `@tomorrow 10am` shows `◔ TOMORROW 10:00` right over the line, not hidden under the keyboard.

- **Fixed: the `> new quest` bar hanging in the middle of the screen.** The bar now rides the keyboard only while you're typing in it. Both keyboard trackers can end typing, and the bar checks itself regularly while it's up. If it ever happens again, long-press the title for the developer screen, which has a KEYBOARD LOG to send me.

- **Completing a quest is smooth to the end.** It slides away, and then the list closes the gap: the quests below glide up instead of jumping. The same happens when you swipe a task away, or restore or delete one on COMPLETED.
- **Nothing jumps away while you work.** Ticking off an objective no longer sends its quest to the top mid-tap. The list sorts itself again when you switch tabs. New quests still appear at the top.
- **A subtle glow:** the title, the selected tab and the ACTIVE / COMPLETED bar, the quick-add field while you type, the toolbar and menu icons, and UNDO.
- **The ACTIVE · COMPLETED switch is 10% smaller.**

- **Fixed for good: the `> new quest` bar hanging in the middle of the screen.** The earlier fix covered one cause; others remained, such as switching to another app while typing, or closing **Move to…** with its search keyboard up. The bar now checks itself against the real keyboard: whenever it comes to rest, whenever you return to the app, and whenever the keyboard closes. If it's up with no keyboard under it, it slides back down.

- **Back never closes the app from the middle of something.** While typing a new quest, back (or closing the keyboard) ends typing and leaves the bar as `> new quest`; what you typed stays. Back also ends editing a task, and clears an `IN: GROUP` target, before anything else. The app only closes when nothing is selected or open.

- **Every tab switch shows the list from the top,** including ACTIVE ↔ COMPLETED, which used to keep the old position. Zooming out of a quest still takes you back to where you were. All 32 one-tap moves between the tabs are now checked automatically.

- **Fixed: completed daily quests now show on DAILY · COMPLETED.** A daily quest from before the quest tabs existed dropped to MAIN once completed. Ones already filed there move back to DAILY by themselves. **Run again** also puts a quest back on its own tab now, instead of on MAIN.
- **Switching between ALL · DAILY · MAIN · MISC always shows the list from the top.** Inside a tab, zooming out of a quest still takes you back to where you were.
- **Smoother, more consistent animations:**
- The `+18` on the XP bar now floats in step with the `+18 XP` on the task you completed, in the same style.
- The toast slides away instead of vanishing, and its UNDO can't be tapped by accident while it leaves.
- A dragged task lifts smoothly instead of jumping up.
- The editing glow fades in the same way everywhere.
- Progress meters no longer fill or drain on their own while you scroll.
- A "found it" flash no longer carries over onto another task.

- **Objectives show every word with a capital:** `buy oat milk` reads **Buy Oat Milk**. Only the display changes: what you typed is kept as it is, and it's what you see when you edit or copy. Words you wrote with capitals of their own (`iPhone`, `NASA`) are left alone.
Smoother navigation, a better moment when you finish something, and a bug fix.

- **Fixed: the `> new quest` bar could get stuck in the middle of the screen.** This happened after a sheet (due date, the hold menu) was opened while the keyboard was up. Sheets now wait for the keyboard to close before they open, and the bar drops back down by itself if it is ever lifted with no keyboard under it.

- **Completing a task feels like it.** The checkbox pops, a green scan line sweeps across the row, and the XP you earned rises from it (`+18 XP`). A completed quest stays where it is while this plays, then slides out to the right.
- **Objectives start with a capital letter.** Whatever you type, paste or quick-add into a quest is saved that way, and older ones are shown that way.
- **Navigation:**
- **Tap the title** (`<7>_quest_log`) to go home: ALL quests, ACTIVE, at the top.
- **Tap the tab you're on again** to go to its top: out of a zoomed-in quest first, otherwise the list scrolls up.
- **Each tab and zoom level keeps its own place.** Switch tabs, or zoom out of a quest, and you're back where you were. Lists slide in from the side they're on, so you can tell which way you moved.
- **Zoomed into a quest you just completed?** You're taken back out once its completion has played, instead of staying inside a finished quest.
- **The breadcrumb names the tab you're on** (`← DAILY`), since that's where it takes you back to.
A pass over navigation.
- **The back button knows the tabs now.** It steps out of selection, then search, then zoom, then COMPLETED back to ACTIVE, then back to ALL, and only then leaves the app.
- **Switching tabs closes what was open:** an edit in progress is saved, and selection ends, instead of being left behind on rows the new tab doesn't show.
- **Search follows the tab you're on** and the same order as the list.
- **Opening a task from a reminder** switches to a tab that shows it.
- **Opening a task from a link while the app is open** no longer stacks a second main screen, so back leaves the app as expected.
- **Zoomed into a quest, its objectives look and act like objectives,** not like quests.
- **Consistent screens:** Trash has the same header divider as the other screens, and Move to… has the same framed close button.
